title: ProxyDash Server and Traffic Monitor
tech: Python, psutil, HTTP API, Linux, systemd, SSH
summary: A read-only server and proxy dashboard with explicit measurement limits and stale-data handling.
achievements: Samples CPU, memory, disk, TCP connections and throughput every two seconds; retains ten minutes of in-memory traffic history.
Preserves the last snapshot on sampling failure and marks stale readings, errors and insufficient permissions.
Supports systemd deployment, loopback-only listening, SSH forwarding and desktop/mobile layouts.
limits: Client counts estimate unique remote TCP IPs, not physical devices. Interface throughput is not per-user billing. Existing deployment evidence is historical; no server was changed during publication.
